Gained when: From story events (most often row 3, after the crew called its evac)
What it does: Nobody takes them seriously: every story event **Twist** test the crew makes has **-1 die**
People keep their word to them: every story event **Twist** test the crew makes has **+1 die**

Gained when: Two captives' fates carried out in one break, or story events
What it does: Everyone has a story about them: on story event **row 5** (captives), the crew rolls twice and chooses. People talk to those they fear: **+1 die** on the crew's first Hunt leads test each break

Gained when: A fulfilled Boast, or story events
What it does: The crew may swear one more Word each battle, which must be a Boast. It stacks with the Big mouth captain trait

Gained when: Two failed Words in one battle, or story events
What it does: This crew may not swear wagers. Patrons do not trust them: **-1 die** on the crew's first Work a job test each break

Gained when: Two captives ransomed at the lowest price allowed in one break, or story events
What it does: People remember a kindness: when the crew gains this tag, it gains one **contact** of its choice (section 14.8), if it has fewer than three

Gained when: Two Words fulfilled in one battle, one of them Big or Legendary, or story events
What it does: The stake of a wager this crew swears is doubled, won or lost. Patrons pay those who keep their word: **+1 die** on the crew's first Work a job test each break
